SELECT r.role_code FROM admin_role r JOIN admin_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.role_code

SELECT DISTINCT p.perm_code FROM admin_permission p JOIN admin_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id JOIN admin_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id JOIN admin_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.perm_code
